records.jp: こんなところまで飛ばされてたなんて
records.en_original: I can't believe we were thrown all the way out here.
records.en: I can't believe we were thrown all the way out here.

records.jp: 瑠夏ちゃん……準備はいい？
records.en_original: Are you ready, Ruka?
records.en: Are you ready, Ruka-chan?

records.jp: ……もちろん。<CR>行くわよ、陽桜莉
records.en_original: Of course. Let's go, Hiori.
records.en: Of course.<CR>Let's go, Hiori.

records.jp: 空だ
records.en_original: It's the sky.
records.en: It's the sky.

records.jp: 夜の空……星がいっぱいの夜空が見える
records.en_original: The night sky... I can see it full of stars.
records.en: The night sky... I can see it full of stars.

records.jp: これは……この記憶は……
records.en_original: This memory is...
records.en: This memory is...

records.jp: 何考えてるのか当てようか？<CR>明日のこと、考えてるでしょ
records.en_original: Want me to guess what's on your mind? You're thinking about tomorrow, right?
records.en: Want me to guess what's on your mind?<CR>You're thinking about tomorrow, right?

records.jp: す、すごいね瑠夏ちゃん。<CR>どうしてわかっちゃったの？
records.en_original: W-wow, you're amazing, Ruka! How did you know?
records.en: W-wow, you're amazing,<CR>Ruka-chan! How did you know?

records.jp: 明日コモンへ行くとなったら、それしかないって。<CR>私も、そのことで頭の中いっぱいだし
records.en_original: If we're going to the Common tomorrow, that's all there is to think about. I can't get it out of my head either.
records.en: If we're going to the Common tomorrow, that's all I can think about.<CR>I can't get it out of my head either.

records.jp: あはは、そうだよね……
records.en_original: Haha, yeah, you're right...
records.en: Haha, yeah, you're right...

records.jp: ……不安？
records.en_original: Are you nervous?
records.en: Are you nervous?

records.jp: ううん、平気。<CR>瑠夏ちゃんが一緒にいてくれるの、わかってるから
records.en_original: No, I'm okay. I know you'll be right there with me, Ruka.
records.en: No, I'm okay.<CR>I know you'll be right there with me, Ruka-chan.

records.jp: そっか……強くなったね、陽桜莉
records.en_original: I see... You've gotten stronger, Hiori.
records.en: I see... You've gotten stronger, Hiori.

records.jp: 私は、ちょっと緊張してる……
records.en_original: I'm a little nervous myself...
records.en: I'm a little nervous myself...

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: 紫乃に支配されたコモンがどうなっているのか。<CR>何が待ち受けているのか
records.en_original: What's happened to the Common now that Shino controls it? What's waiting for us there?
records.en: What's happened to the Common now that Shino controls it?<CR>What's waiting for us there?

records.jp: もし失敗したら、この世界はどうなってしまうのか。<CR>いろんなこと考えちゃって……
records.en_original: What will happen to this world if we mess something up? My mind is racing...
records.en: What will happen to this world if we mess something up?<CR>My mind is racing...

records.jp: ねえねえ瑠夏ちゃん。<CR>来年の七夕祭りの話なんだけどさ！
records.en_original: Hey, come on, Ruka. Let's think about next year's Tanabata Festival!
records.en: Hey, come on, Ruka-chan.<CR>Let's think about next year's Tanabata Festival!

records.jp: うん……はい？
records.en_original: Uh...huh?
records.en: Uh...huh?

records.jp: 来年はさ、一緒に浴衣着ようよ。<CR>それで一緒に花火を見に行くってどうかな？
records.en_original: Next year, let's wear yukata together. And maybe go watch the fireworks! What do you think?
records.en: Next year, let's wear yukata together.<CR>And maybe go watch the fireworks! What do you think?

records.jp: ちょ、ちょっと陽桜莉。<CR>急に来年の話なんて……
records.en_original: W-wait, Hiori! Isn't it jumping the gun a bit to start planning for next year?
records.en: W-wait, Hiori!<CR>Isn't it jumping the gun a bit to start planning for next year?

records.jp: どんなお願いしようかな～？<CR>やっぱりここは、世界平和！　とか？
records.en_original: I wonder what I should wish for? Maybe...world peace! Or something else?
records.en: I wonder what I should wish for?<CR>Maybe...world peace! Or something else?

records.jp: って、リフレクターの私が願っちゃダメかな？<CR>願う暇があったら動け、って怒られちゃいそうだし
records.en_original: Wait, is it okay for me to wish for that as a Reflector? I'll probably get scolded that I should work to bring about peace, not wish for it.
records.en: Wait, is it okay for me to wish for that as a Reflector? I'll probably<CR>get scolded that I should work to bring about peace, not wish for it.

records.jp: ……ぷっ
records.en_original: ...Pfft.
records.en: ...Pfft.

records.jp: ふふっ……モモさんと白樺さんは確実に言いそう
records.en_original: Hehe... That's totally something Momo and Miyako would say.
records.en: Hehe... That's totally something Momo-san and Shirakaba-san would say.

records.jp: だよねぇ……。<CR>じゃあ、違うお願いごとにしないと
records.en_original: Right? Guess I should pick a different wish.
records.en: Right?<CR>Guess I should pick a different wish.

records.jp: おいしいもの食べたいとか、美弦さんに甘えたいとか、<CR>そういうのでいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: How about something like eating yummy food, or getting to be spoiled by Mio? That should be fine, right?
records.en: How about something like eating yummy food, or getting to be spoiled by Mio-san?<CR>That should be fine, right?

records.jp: えぇ～、なんか子供っぽくないかなぁ？<CR>瑠夏ちゃんはどんなお願いする？
records.en_original: Doesn't that sound kind of childish? What about you, Ruka? What would you wish for?
records.en: Doesn't that sound kind of childish?<CR>What about you, Ruka-chan? What would you wish for?

records.jp: 来年のお願い、か……うーん……
records.en_original: My wish for next year? Hmm...
records.en: My wish for next year? Hmm...

records.jp: なんだか、世界平和って書いちゃいそう
records.en_original: I feel like I'd just end up writing world peace on my wish slip or something like that.
records.en: I feel like I'd just end up writing world peace on my wish slip or something like that.

records.jp: あはは、瑠夏ちゃんも同じじゃん
records.en_original: Haha, see? You're just like me, Ruka.
records.en: Haha, see? You're just like me, Ruka-chan.

records.jp: じゃあ、みんな幸せになりますように、とかは？
records.en_original: Okay, then how about something like, "I hope everyone's happy all the time"?
records.en: Okay, then how about something like, "I hope everyone's happy all the time"?

records.jp: 変わらないよぉ
records.en_original: That's not really all that different!
records.en: That's not really all that different!

records.jp: ふふっ、あははは……。<CR>ほんとお互い、高校生らしくないね
records.en_original: Hehe... Hahaha! We're honestly the least highschool-ish high schoolers imaginable.
records.en: Hehe, hahaha...<CR>We really don't act like high schoolers, do we?

records.jp: だねぇ
records.en_original: Seriously.
records.en: Seriously.

records.jp: 来年の七夕は、そんな願いが浮かばないくらい、<CR>平和な毎日になっててくれたら嬉しいな
records.en_original: I'd be so happy if life was so peaceful we didn't even think of wishes like those by next Tanabata.
records.en: I'd be so happy if life was so peaceful we didn't even<CR>think of wishes like those by next Tanabata.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: ふぅ……なんだか、陽桜莉と話してたら<CR>緊張してた気持ちがほぐれたみたい
records.en_original: Phew... Somehow, talking with you calmed me down completely.
records.en: Phew... Somehow, talking with you<CR>calmed me down completely.

records.jp: ありがとう、陽桜莉。<CR>さすが、頼りになるバディだね
records.en_original: Thank you, Hiori. You're always such a reliable friend.
records.en: Thanks, Hiori.<CR>You're such a dependable partner.

records.jp: えへへ……よかった
records.en_original: Hehe... Glad I could help.
records.en: Hehe... Glad I could help.

records.jp: ……絶対、帰ってこようね。<CR>来年の七夕、一緒じゃないとヤダよ？
records.en_original: Let's definitely make it back home, okay? I don't want to spend next Tanabata without you.
records.en: Let's definitely make it back home, okay?<CR>I don't want to spend next Tanabata without you.

records.jp: うん。私も、陽桜莉と一緒じゃないとヤダ。<CR>絶対に生きて帰ろう
records.en_original: Me too. I couldn't stand it if we weren't together. Let's both make it out alive.
records.en: Me too. I couldn't stand it if we weren't together.<CR>Let's both make it out alive.

records.jp: そうだ。私たちもお姉ちゃんたちと同じだ
records.en_original: That's right. We're just like Sis and Momo.
records.en: That's right. We're just like Onee-chan and Momo-san.

records.jp: この世界でやりたいことがある。<CR>瑠夏ちゃんとの約束がある
records.en_original: There's still things I want to do in this world. Things I promised to do with you, Ruka.
records.en: There are still things I want to do in this world.<CR>I have a promise to keep with you, Ruka-chan.

records.jp: 大切なバディとの大事な約束
records.en_original: An important promise with a precious partner.
records.en: An important promise with a precious partner.

records.jp: 平和になった今の世界で、<CR>来年の七夕を一緒に過ごすこと
records.en_original: To spend next Tanabata together in this peaceful world.
records.en: To spend next Tanabata<CR>together in this peaceful world.

records.jp: この世界が正しいかどうかなんてわからないし、<CR>それを決める権利は私にはない
records.en_original: I don't know if this world is the right one, or if I even have the right to decide that.
records.en: I don't know if this world is the right one,<CR>or if I even have the right to decide that.

records.jp: けど、この世界にだってたくさんの想いがある。<CR>終わらせちゃいけない、大切な想いが
records.en_original: But there are so many feelings here. So many precious feelings that can't be thrown away.
records.en: But this world is full of feelings too.<CR>Precious feelings we can't let vanish.

records.jp: 正しい世界を求める紫乃。<CR>その想いを否定するつもりはない
records.en_original: Shino wants a perfect world. I don't intend to deny what she feels.
records.en: Shino wants to create the world she believes is right.<CR>I don't intend to deny those feelings.

records.jp: けど、だからといって世界を終わらせる権利が<CR>紫乃にあるとは思わない
records.en_original: But even so, I don't think Shino has the right to end the world we live in.
records.en: But even so, I don't think Shino has the right to end<CR>the world we live in.

records.jp: 私たちは、この世界を守る
records.en_original: We're going to protect this world.
records.en: We're going to protect this world.

records.jp: 紫乃に会って、やめさせる
records.en_original: We're going to find Shino and bring this all to an end.
records.en: We're going to find Shino and stop her.

records.jp: それが私たちが、コモンに来た目的だから
records.en_original: That's why we came to the Common.
records.en: That's why we came to the Common.

records.jp: それが私たちが、コモンに来た目的だから
records.en_original: That's why we came to the Common.
records.en: That's why we came to the Common.

records.jp: ……思い出した。<CR>私たちがコモンに来た時の想いを
records.en_original: I remember now... Those were the feelings we had when we first came to the Common.
records.en: I remember now...<CR>Those were the feelings we had when we first came to the Common.

records.jp: 私たちは、紫乃ちゃんを説得するために来たんだ。<CR>この世界を、絶対に終わらせたりなんてさせない！
records.en_original: We came here to convince Shino. We can't let this world end, no matter what!
records.en: We came here to convince Shino-chan.<CR>We can't let this world end, no matter what!

records.jp: やったね、二人とも
records.en_original: You two did it!
records.en: You two did it!

records.jp: フラグメントを包んでいた黒い力、<CR>今ので完全に消えたよ！
records.en_original: The dark power that was surrounding your Fragments is completely gone now!
records.en: The dark power that was surrounding your<CR>Fragments is completely gone now!

records.jp: 今は、なんだか温かい力に包まれてる。<CR>みんなの想いが二人のフラグメントを守ってるみたい
records.en_original: It seems like they're wrapped in a warm energy now. It's as if everyone's feelings are protecting both of your Fragments.
records.en: It seems like they're wrapped in a warm energy now.<CR>It's as if everyone's feelings are protecting both of your Fragments.

records.jp: これなら、紫乃も簡単に手を出せないと思う
records.en_original: I don't think Shino will be able to interfere so easily now.
records.en: I don't think Shino will be able to interfere so easily now.

records.jp: みんなの想いが、私たちを強くしてくれた……。<CR>ありがとう、みんな
records.en_original: Everyone's emotions have made us stronger... Thank you, everyone.
records.en: Everyone's emotions have made us stronger...<CR>Thank you, everyone.

records.jp: 紫乃ちゃんはこの近くにいるはず。<CR>探そう、瑠夏ちゃん！
records.en_original: Shino should be nearby. Let's look for her, Ruka!
records.en: Shino-chan should be nearby.<CR>Let's look for her, Ruka-chan!
